name: radar-profile
title: Radar Profile
description: Two-entity radar (spider) chart — overlapping strength polygons over shared 0-100 axes with a legend.

meta.question: Where does A beat B, and where does it lose?
meta.whenToUse: Head-to-head profile of two entities across 4-8 comparable dimensions normalized to 0-100 (capability profiles, skill matchups).
meta.antiUse: Exactly 2 entities on a 0-100 scale only — not for 3+ overlapping shapes, unnormalized metrics, or precise value reading (use rank bars or a table).
